title: Check-Funded Deposits and the Fleet Order Deposit Rate
content:
**Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement. Deposit desk note: deposits received by check**

Deposits paid by check add a check-funds rate to the order deposit rate. The count is taken from the deposits received on the deal itself.

- Two or more deposits on the deal received by check add **2 percent (0.02)**.
- Exactly one deposit received by check adds **1 percent (0.01)**.
- No deposit received by check adds nothing.

**Input, judgement, output**

| Deposits received on the deal by check | Check-funds rate added |
|---|---|
| 0 | nothing |
| 1 | 1 percent |
| 2 | 2 percent |
| 3 or more | 2 percent |

**Hypothetical cases**
- The reservation deposit was paid by cashier's check and a second deposit by ACH. No deposit was received by check, so nothing is added.
- The reservation deposit was paid by check and a later deposit by check. Two check deposits add 2 percent.
- One check deposit and one ACH deposit add 1 percent.

Cashier's checks and ACH transfers are separate payment methods and do not count as deposits received by check.
